verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rootly offers a REST API with API-key auth (rootly-docs-11, rootly-docs-24, rootly-docs-49) and an MCP server for agentic tool use, but there is no mention anywhere of official client SDKs (e.g., Python/JS/Go libraries) for developers to build against — the OpenAPI spec probe even returned 404s (rootly-probe-2), suggesting no formal SDK generation pipeline is publicly documented.
